articles.title: 'Too Late, Mr. President': Araghchi Mocks Macron, Reminds Him Of Support To US Amid French Riots
articles.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has sharply criticised French President Emmanuel Macron, accusing him of contributing to the conflict involving Iran and then blaming the war for France’s economic and political pressures. Araghchi seized on the latest protests in France to urge Macron to “listen to the future of France,” while Tehran also accused the French leader of double standards on military deterrence. His remarks came as nationwide demonstrations over living costs and public services triggered mass arrests, looting and fresh political pressure on Macron’s government.

articles.title: France Erupts In Protests: Why Macron Faces Growing Anger Over Living Costs And Public Services
articles.description: France is witnessing widespread unrest as protests over rising living costs, cuts to public services and education funding escalate into riots across Paris, Lyon and Marseille. Buildings have been set on fire, shops looted and more than 1,200 people reportedly detained. President Emmanuel Macron and Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu have vowed a tough response, while protesters point to economic hardship and growing inequality as key drivers of the anger.
